C1194.title: Taiyuan Police Dismantle a Five-Tier SMS Bombing Criminal Chain
C1194.summary: In January 2025, the Jinyuan branch of the Taiyuan Public Security Bureau dismantled a five-tier SMS bombing chain spanning Shanxi, Fujian, Jiangsu, and Guangdong. Police detained five suspects and seized several bombing tools. The investigation found that the group sold software and provided SMS-bombing services through multiple agent levels, involving more than 5,000 targeted phone numbers and over 2,200 software copies.
